name: ACT 1 - FIRST SIGNAL: Name the Host
description:
The compromised endpoint has been identified at the network-interface level. Determine the Windows hostname assigned to the affected workstation.

Mission:
Determine the Windows hostname of the compromised endpoint.

Evidence:
ACT12026-08-09-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap

Submission requirement:
Answer: pcgCTF{...}
Filter: ...
Evidence: Packet/Stream ...

Hint:
Investigate DHCP, LLMNR, NBNS, Kerberos, LDAP, or SMB traffic that can reveal workstation identity. Correlate the hostname with the compromised IP address.

Prerequisite:
ACT 1 - FIRST SIGNAL: Hardware Fingerprint
